sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*Lp-PLA\\(2\\) activity[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '21982651' LIMIT 5
rows: Darapladib inhibits Lp-PLA(2) activity in plasma and in arterial plaques and may confer clinical benefit in preventing cardiovascular events
